# A32X Tools

> Aircraft maintenance reference apps for line and base maintenance technicians: A32X Tools (Airbus A318/A319/A320/A321), A330 Tools (Airbus A330) and 737 Tools (Boeing 737 NG). iOS and Android, one-time purchase, fully offline. For training and reference only; they do not replace official manuals.
>
> 面向航线和定检维修技术人员的飞机维修参考应用：A32X Tools（空客 A318/A319/A320/A321）、A330 Tools（空客 A330）和 737 Tools（波音 737 NG）。一次性购买，完全离线。在中国可通过 App Store 下载（Google Play 在中国大陆不可用）。仅供培训和参考，不能替代官方手册。

## Apps / 应用

- [A32X Tools · A320 ECAM Resets](https://www.a32xtools.com/a32x-tools/): ECAM reset procedures with the circuit breakers and panel photos for each message, A320neo avionics compartment photo tour, structural damage reports (PDF/ZIP), electrical contacts with ESPM references, Alpha Callups and common part numbers.
- [A32X Tools 中文介绍](https://www.a32xtools.com/zh/a32x-tools/): A320 ECAM 复位程序、跳开关及面板照片、A320neo 电子设备舱照片导览、结构损伤报告、电气触点、Alpha Callups 和常用件号。
- [A330 Tools](https://www.a32xtools.com/a330-tools/): ECAM reset procedures with circuit breakers and panel photos, structural damage reports, electrical contacts, Alpha Callups and common part numbers for the A330.
- [A330 Tools 中文介绍](https://www.a32xtools.com/zh/a330-tools/): A330 ECAM 复位程序、跳开关及面板照片、结构损伤报告、电气触点、Alpha Callups 和常用件号。
- [737 Tools · Annunciator Lights](https://www.a32xtools.com/737-tools/): every 737 NG annunciator light by ATA chapter with fault modes, LRUs, circuit breakers and MEL items; photographic E/E compartment tour; circuit breaker panels; common part numbers; damage reports; MEL due-date calculator.
- [737 Tools 中文介绍](https://www.a32xtools.com/zh/737-tools/): 按 ATA 章节整理的 737 NG 告警灯（故障模式、LRU、跳开关、MEL）、电子设备舱照片导览、跳开关面板、常用件号、损伤报告和 MEL 到期日计算器。
